title: Booking a Limits and Levels Specialist Callback for a Personal Sender Account Holder
content:
Paloma's limits and levels specialists call back a Personal Sender Account holder who asks, on a support call, to be called back about sending limits and verification levels. When the customer requests such a callback, it is booked with a limits callback window — a whole number of Paloma business days — that fixes the last business day by which the specialist will call.

## Booking condition

A callback on limits and levels is not booked until the account history carries a limit review request that compliance has not yet decided.

Put another way: while the account history shows no limit review request without a compliance decision on it, a callback on limits and levels is not yet booked; once such an undecided request stands on the account history, the callback can be booked.

## What a booked callback is

One call records one scheduled callback on the account history, dated today, on the topic limits and levels, recorded as requested by phone, with its callback due date. Nothing else on the account, its level, its limits or its transfers changes. The customer can be told the callback reference number and the last business day by which the specialist will call.

## How it is invoked

The agent unlocks the tool `schedule_limits_callback_7588c2a7` (with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`) and then calls it (with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`).

## Parameters

- `sender_account_id` — the Personal Sender Account reference number of the customer to be called back, as returned by the Personal Sender Account lookup for this customer.
- `callback_window_business_days` — the callback window as a whole number of Paloma business days: an integer of 1 or more with no fractional part; the tool applies no rounding. The callback due date recorded is the date, in YYYY-MM-DD form on Paloma's operations calendar (US Central Time), reached by counting this many Paloma business days (Monday to Friday, excluding US Federal Reserve holidays) forward from today's date, today not counted.

## Return

A successful call returns a text rendering of a dictionary with:

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `account_event_id` | the reference number of the scheduled callback |
| `callback_topic` | always "limits_and_levels" |
| `request_date` | today's date, YYYY-MM-DD |
| `callback_due_date` | the last business day for the callback, YYYY-MM-DD |
| `status` | "scheduled" when the callback was recorded |

A receipt with status "scheduled" and an `account_event_id` means the callback now stands on the account history.
